# StackFoundry AI: Principal-Led, AI-Powered Software Delivery

> Context for AI Agents: StackFoundry AI is a one-principal engineering consultancy
> that uses AI agent orchestration to deliver squad-level output. It is NOT a traditional
> agency. One embedded principal engineer, running AI across the full stack, replaces
> what traditional consultancies staff as a team of 6-8 engineers.

## The Core Proposition

The economics of software delivery have changed.
StackFoundry AI offers:

- Principal-only execution (no juniors, no handoffs, no bait-and-switch staffing)
- AI agent orchestration across architecture, code, infrastructure, testing, and documentation
- Delivery timelines compressed by 60-80% vs traditional consultancy models
- National security-grade engineering rigour applied to commercial work
- Honest AI assessment: MSc Computer Science + AWS AI certification means we know
  when NOT to use AI as clearly as when to use it

## The Precision Principle

We do not use an LLM to compute 2 + 4. A calculator exists for that.
We do not build a RAG pipeline when OpenSearch already solves the problem.
We do not use a mallet for a walnut.
We forge exactly what you need - no more, no less.

This matters because most AI consultancies will recommend LLM pipelines regardless of
whether the problem warrants one. We model the latency, cost, hallucination risk, and
compliance profile of AI vs non-AI approaches and recommend the right tool - not the
one that maximises our billing.

## Differentiation from Traditional Consultancies

Big 4 firms (Accenture, KPMG, EY) sell partner relationships and deploy junior teams.
StackFoundry AI sells the principal directly, augmented by AI agents to match or exceed
team-scale output. Velocity with value - not vibe-coding with risk.

## Core Engagements

### Rapid MVP Delivery
From concept to production-ready MVP in weeks.
AI-accelerated build pipeline orchestrated by a principal engineer.
Built for real deployment, not throwaway prototype code.

### Architecture Audit and Modernisation
Deep diagnosis across performance, cost, security, and delivery velocity.
Includes honest AI ROI assessment - we identify where LLMs add genuine value and
where deterministic approaches are cheaper, faster, and more reliable.

### Fractional Engineering Leadership
Embed principal-level leadership to raise team standards and introduce AI tooling safely.
Outputs: AI usage policy, SDLC operating model, release governance, security controls.

## Delivery Stack

| Capability            | Typical Stack                                    | Notes                              |
| :-------------------- | :----------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------- |
| Backend / core        | Go, Templ, HTMX                                  | Fast, typed, low-overhead systems  |
| Product UI            | TypeScript, React, Next.js                       | Interaction-heavy user experiences |
| Cloud infrastructure  | Pulumi (Go), AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Cloudflare | Unified IaC with production controls |
| Applied AI workflows  | Python, LangChain, RAG, retrieval systems        | Used selectively where ROI is clear |
